title: Domestic joy beyond binding order

captions.physics: Maintaining familiar comfort at freedom’s expense
captions.emotions: Enjoying clear results of shared care

meaning: Your domestic support brings more warmth when joy does not preserve every earlier convenience and both can review a rule making its maintenance compulsory.
text: The Devil in the physical position of Muladhara describes domestic actions maintaining familiar comfort even at the cost of free choice. The Emperor in energy fixes them through rigid rules. The Sun in emotions wants to enjoy a visible result. Something good can become conditional. Both gain pleasure only while maintaining the entire former quantity. Rejecting excess supposedly violates order and removes permission to enjoy available care although its present benefit does not require every earlier form to remain unchanged.

For example, many dishes are kept for a beautiful shared dinner. Use is pleasant, but washing and placement follow an unchangeable scheme and the selection cannot shrink. **Joy in meeting need not preserve every binding maintenance rule around it.** You can recognise pleasure and select enough. Domestic choice returns to both instead of enjoyment becoming a reward earned only after fulfilling the whole earlier procedure regardless of actual tiredness, free time and present wishes.

The difficulty is considering reduction a threat to a good shared image. Work remains while joy becomes increasingly conditional. Distinguishing an occasion’s value from compulsory scale offers more dependable support: a simpler meeting can stay warm. Support grows when both choose present comfort without making every pleasant experience first confirm the untouchability of all rules through which it once was arranged. The ritual’s benefit can be preserved through different conditions.
